Round 375 (PERF-11c-iii-b) is implemented and ready for C. The checks I ran all pass and nothing hit a STOP. Nothing visible changes in the Studio: the Library and its preview just stop re-rendering when you zoom, mute a lane or undo.

**What changed:** exactly the 7 granted files.
- I applied B's dispatched patch to the 6 code and test files without editing it. Its hash matched, `patch -p1` returned 0, and all 6 files match B's file hashes.
- I wrote the new Georgian doc `docs/implementation/2026/quarter-IV/242-perf-library-leaves.md`. Line 4 reads exactly `Completed (C round 375 PASS)`, it has all the template headings in order, and it names only test rows and files that exist.

**Checks I ran** (logs in `a-round-375/`):
- `npm run typecheck`: passes.
- `npm run lint`: passes, with 205 warnings and 1 info, the same summary as gate 374.
- `npx biome check` on the 6 patched files: passes.
- The 140 covering test files: 2198 of 2198 tests pass. No test is above 50 % of its declared timeout, in my run or in gate 374's log.
- My own browser smoke on the running :5173 server at 1440×900 and 1280×720:
  - Bass added with Enter (0 → 1 clip).
  - On the Video lane, Add is disabled with the title "Add — make an audio track active first". Back on Music it is enabled again.
  - No page errors.
  - The first attempt timed out on a cold start; the warm rerun is the result.

**Code review:** the code-reviewer scored it 8/10 with no Critical or High findings.
- Its Medium was that the doc cited paths that don't exist. Those are loop files outside the repo, so I wrote them out as full `tmp/studio-real-loop/…` paths in the doc.
- Three findings are in the test files, which I'm not allowed to edit, so they go to B as Lows:
  - `drag-preview-render.test.tsx` has no in-file check that its renamed counter name is real (render-budget's RB-LEAF3 row covers that). The reviewer called this "Low–Medium". If B or C rate it Medium, it is a problem in B's patch, not something I changed.
  - The comparator treats a key that exists only on the old side with value `undefined` as "equal". This is harmless, but it is not a strict two-sided check.
  - RB-LEAF3 checks the mute, zoom and Undo steps together rather than one at a time.
- Only the doc changed after the review. The reviewer checked it again: 9/10, nothing at Medium or above left.
- Architecture proposal for B and root (not done this round): move the comparator and the track-label type into `app/lib/arrangement/` as part of the open architecture checkpoint.

**Not run, left for C and the gate:** the frozen and protected hash checks, claims, the shuffled unit runs, mutants, perf, the leaf probe, the Library and auth browser rows, and the full suite, verify and build.
